import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(new OutputStreamWriter(System.out));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int t = 1; // as per original code, t is set to 1
        for (int _ = 0; _ < t; _++) {
            solve(br, out);
        }
        out.flush();
    }

    static void solve(BufferedReader br, PrintWriter out) throws IOException {
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        double[] allp = new double[n];

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            allp[i] = Double.parseDouble(st.nextToken());
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (Math.abs(allp[i]) < 1e-6) {
                out.print("0 ");
                continue;
            }
            int size = 1 << (n - 1);
            double[] dp = new double[size];
            double[] p = new double[n - 1];
            int c = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i != j) {
                    p[c++] = allp[j];
                }
            }
            dp[0] = allp[i];
            double ans = dp[0];
            for (int mask = 1; mask < size; mask++) {
                double sumP = 0.0;
                double sum = 0.0;
                int cnt = 0;
                for (int t = 0; t < n - 1; t++) {
                    if ((mask & (1 << t)) != 0) {
                        sumP += p[t];
                        sum += p[t] * dp[mask ^ (1 << t)];
                        cnt++;
                    }
                }
                double denom = 1 - sumP;
                if (Math.abs(denom) < 1e-12) {
                    // To avoid division by zero, skip or handle accordingly
                    continue;
                }
                dp[mask] = sum / denom;
                if (cnt < k) {
                    ans += dp[mask];
                }
            }
            out.print(ans + " ");
        }
    }
}
